verdict.rationale: Google publishes storage tiers and pricing on a public page (one.google.com/about/plans), e.g. 100GB and 2TB total storage across Photos/Drive/Gmail and sharing with up to 5 others, giving founders visible quotas and consumer pricing. However, missing for 10: explicit per-user Google Workspace (business) pricing tiers, and any documentation of what happens when a user hits the storage cap (blocked uploads, grace period, etc.) — none of the evidence addresses cap behavior.
